description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Private Pool + Gorgeous Covered Deck* Pet Friendly (Fees and Restrictions Apply; See Below)* Blue Mtn Beach Regional Beach Access only 700yds Away* 4 Bikes Included* Great Outdoor Areas for Dining + Relaxing* Master Bedroom with balcony access overlooking the Private Pool* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef- more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under 25. No Exceptions.* Welcome to the stunning 3-story Saint Cecilia home, located in the heart of 30A. This spacious 5-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom retreat is perfect for family getaways. Enjoy relaxing in the amazing backyard while the kids splash around in your private pool. The chef in your group will appreciate the modern kitchen, featuring plenty of storage for all the essentials to prepare your next delicious meal. The dining area offers ample seating for everyone to gather and enjoy meals together. On the second floor, you'll find a luxurious king master suite with an en-suite bathroom and private balcony, along with a second king guest bedroom, also with its en-suite bathroom. The third floor offers even more space with two additional king guest bedrooms, one with en-suite bathrooms, plus a third guest room featuring 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds—making this home ideal for up to 12 guests. Enjoy sitting on the balcony that overlooks the pool. Come experience what makes Saint Cecilia so special!** Please note: Pet Fee is $250/pet and is nonrefundable. Please note we can accept requests for 2 dogs under 25 lbs. or one larger dog. Pets are subject to approval.Saint Cecilia is located in the charming village of Blue Mountain Beach, tucked between Highway 30A and hundreds of acres of State Forest. Saint Cecilia is convenient to the beach, shopping, and other hotspots while still being quiet and secluded. You will love the charming community pool and take a stroll to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for a delicious treat. This community is centrally located, making it easy to drive to many locations, including the neighboring communities of WaterColor and Seaside. The Bed Setup: 2nd Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom 1: King Bed3rd Floor:Guest Bedroom 2: King BedGuest Bedroom 3: King BedGuest Bedroom 3: 2 Twin/Twin Bunk Beds*We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs every month from January through February. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please get in touch with us with your interest and to further assist!Area Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
